result.title: BQDNA: Multi-Head Binary Spherical Quantization for Genomic Sequence Modeling
result.summary: Decoding biological information from long, repetitive DNA remains challenging. Genomic language models (gLMs) often follow the conventional language-model pretrain-and-adapt paradigm. However, the lack of inherent semantic segmentation and prior rules makes hand-crafted tokenizers like k-mer and BPE suboptimal. We introduce context-aware \textbf{BQVAE} for scalar quantization of DNA and \textbf{BQDNA}, an autoregressive gLM supporting multi-head codebooks. Comprehensive experiments reveal that: (1) unique training dynamics of vector quantization in DNA space, including the importance of alignment between training corpus and downstream data. (2) superior performance of BQVAE over hand-crafted tokenizers and vanilla VQVAE. (3) remarkable cross-species generalization capability of BQDNA, which achieves state-of-the-art performance with merely 0.1B multi-species training for BQVAE and 1 epoch training on hg38 for BQDNA, outperforming gLMs pretrained with 10$\sim$100x more tokens. Our findings underscore the potential of learned vector quantization for genomic sequence representation. Code is available at https://github.com/Sophie10001b/BQDNA

AI.brief_summary: 提出上下文感知的 BQVAE 与多头码本的 BQDNA，用学习式二值球面量化替代 k-mer/BPE 分词，改进 DNA 序列建模与跨物种泛化。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作面向基因组分词与自回归序列建模，既无视觉或多模态推理，也不涉及 latent 推理状态、证据获取或停止决策；量化码本仅为输入离散化手段，与 LVR 主线缺乏具体可借鉴线索。
